limitations: Only abstracts were mined. Conclusions are not in the harvested metadata, and full text was not collected.
config/gap_regex_patterns.json defines 30 patterns, while the design notes give 32; the config was used as shipped for the strict tier.
The extended tier's markers and cluster keywords are a documented heuristic. Its precision is estimated on a fixed sample and reported in the summary.
mathematical_remediation is the cluster-level remedy for each gap cluster, not a sentence extracted from any paper.
